description: Live coverage of the case-law corpus, one row per corpus (cc = Corte costituzionale, cassazione, cgt): documents, massime, passages, passages_without_embedding (not yet searchable by meaning), last_ingested_at (null for cc: the open data carries no load time), plus the limits of that corpus in note. The cc row also carries the registry counts norme_pending, norme_resolved (linked to a loaded decision) and norme_unresolved; the cgt row carries skipped_without_text, the documents the MEF publishes without text. No parameters.
